note: Statuses recorded by the implementation team on 22 September 2026. passed_lab = automated or headless-browser check in the repository environment; passed_lab_synthetic = layout verified with synthetic fixtures only; partially_passed_lab = part of the pass condition verified; see_backend_matrix = service-level scenarios recorded in docs/audit/BACKEND_QA_MATRIX.md; not_run stays not_run.

tests.scenario: First visit and optional invitation opening
tests.pass_condition: Date/destination and practical shortcuts are available; no required extended animation or audio.
tests.environment: Node 22 + headless Chromium in the repository CI/local environment
evidence: Proofs entry-envelope/entry-opened at 320/390/768/1440 show date, destination and both start times under the sealed envelope plus the entry-bar skip link and RSVP; no audio; reduced motion opens statically (docs/proofs/README.md).
